title: BNB’s $99 million ETF inflows came almost entirely before Binance’s hack
summary: BNB exchange-traded funds (ETFs) led October inflows among US-listed spot crypto ETFs tracked by SoSoValue, with the largest allocation arriving weeks before Binance suffered a record $6.3 billion cryptocurrency hack. The US-listed VanEck BNB ETF attracted $99 million during the month, ahead of $35 million for NEAR and $19 million for XRP, according to SoSoValue… Read the full story on CryptoSlate Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next.
